nws_vef.name: NWS Las Vegas, Technical Memorandum WR-235 (Climate of Las Vegas, Nevada)
nws_vef.publisher: NOAA National Weather Service, Las Vegas (VEF) Forecast Office
nws_vef.citable_for: NWS Las Vegas forecast-office frost/freeze normals for the Las Vegas Valley (1961-90 period of record, 32 degF). Verbatim: average last spring frost Feb 28, average first fall frost Nov 25. The nevada zone 9 frost anchor (zone 8 and zone 10 gradient-derived from it). Not citable for biological-mechanism claims.

PDF re-downloaded + confirmed in the build controller env 2026-07-21.

unr_sp2007.name: UNR Extension SP-20-07, Research Orchard Fruit Evaluations & Recommendations for Southern Nevada (2020)
unr_sp2007.citable_for: UNR Extension specific publication SP-20-07 (M.L. Robinson, A. O'Callaghan, L. Ruskamp; peer-reviewed). Direct multi-year (2005-2018) apple variety field trial at the North Las Vegas Research Orchard (4600 Horse Drive, inside the zone 9 belt), with per-variety performance ratings and chill-hour figures. Backs the nevada apple suitability (fruits_reliably) and the reliable-vs-unproven variety steering (confirmed performers Dorsett Golden / Pink Lady / Mutsu / Anna / Fuji / Granny Smith; confirmed ceiling ~700 hr at Granny Smith). Sub-ID under unr_ext (the parent portal).

unr_fs0261.name: UNR/UNCE Fact Sheet FS-02-61, Home Vegetable Production in Southern Nevada
unr_fs0261.publisher: University of Nevada, Reno Cooperative Extension
unr_fs0261.citable_for: UNR Cooperative Extension Fact Sheet FS-02-61 (A.M. O'Callaghan). The Southern Nevada warm-vs-cool season planting framework: warm-season vegetables planted March through May; cool-season mid-February through April and from mid-August until the end of October; plants do not grow well above 90 degF. Backs the nevada annual season windows and the summer heat_pause. Sub-ID under unr_ext.
unr_fs0261._admission_provenance: nevada region (roadmap item 10, 2026-07-21). Sub-ID under unr_ext (T1, 1862 Land Grant); inherits parent tier. Surfaced: the belt's cool/warm season windows + the 90 degF ceiling (the heat_pause basis). Verbatim extract confirmed via pypdf/fitz in the build controller env 2026-07-21: 'mid February through April and from mid August until the end of October', 'March until May', 'grow well at temperatures above 90 F'.

unr_sp9911.name: UNR Extension SP-99-11, Growing Tomatoes in Southern Nevada
unr_sp9911.citable_for: UNR Extension specific publication SP-99-11 (A. Roberts). Southern Nevada's practical last-frost date (March 15); the >90 degF-day / <55 degF-night tomato fruit-set cutoff; and the recommendation AGAINST a fall or second tomato planting for Southern Nevada (spread the single spring window by mixing early 50-60 day and main-season 80+ day varieties). Backs the nevada warm-fruiting-crop single-spring shape (no fall replant) and the heat_pause. Sub-ID under unr_ext.
unr_sp9911._admission_provenance: nevada region (roadmap item 10, 2026-07-21). Sub-ID under unr_ext (T1, 1862 Land Grant); inherits parent tier. Surfaced: the belt's no-fall-tomato recommendation (the delta-1 divergence from Phoenix's fall reflush) + the practical last-frost date. The 2026-07-15 tier2 Nevada ruling read this publication; catalogued now the belt is built.

unlv_mg_svn.name: Vegetable Planting Guide for Southern Nevada (Clarita Huffman, Master Gardener)
unlv_mg_svn.publisher: University of Nevada Cooperative Extension Master Gardener Program (Clark County), hosted by UNLV
unlv_mg_svn.citable_for: UNR Cooperative Extension Master Gardener (Clark County) per-crop planting chart for Southern Nevada. Cool-season crops carry a spring window (Feb-Apr) and a fall window (mid-Aug through Oct/Nov); warm-season crops a spring window (Mar-May), with quick crops (bush beans, sweet corn, cucumber, summer squash) also a late-summer (Jul-Aug) window; garlic Sept through mid-Oct; dry onions Feb plus Sept-Oct. Backs the nevada per-crop annual windows. A Master Gardener product of a T1 university extension (mirrors nmsu_donaana_mg's admission).
unlv_mg_svn._admission_provenance: nevada region (roadmap item 10, 2026-07-21). extension_master_gardener_program class, mirroring nmsu_donaana_mg (a T1 Master Gardener planting chart). Surfaced: the belt's per-crop planting windows (the load-bearing annual-window source, the Nevada analog of VCE 426-331 / UNLV chart).
